This error occurs because the `prj_mmc.conf` configuration file, which is used for this test, does not enable any specific disk driver (e.g., `CONFIG_DISK_DRIVER_RAM`, `CONFIG_DISK_DRIVER_FLASH`, `CONFIG_DISK_DRIVER_SDMMC`, `CONFIG_DISK_DRIVER_MMC`, or `CONFIG_DISK_DRIVER_VIRTIO_BLK`).

The name `prj_mmc.conf` strongly suggests that this configuration is intended to test the MMC (MultiMediaCard) disk driver. To enable the MMC disk driver, `CONFIG_DISK_DRIVER_MMC=y` must be set. Additionally, the `MMC_SUBSYS` configuration, which depends on `DISK_DRIVER_MMC`, should also be enabled to ensure the full MMC stack is active.

The "too few arguments to function" errors for `fs_statvfs`, `fs_open`, and `fs_rename`, along with the "undeclared `DISK_NAME`" errors, are cascading effects of `DISK_NAME` not being defined. `DISK_NAME` is defined within an `#if/#elif` block in `test_fat.h` that relies on one of the `CONFIG_DISK_DRIVER_XXX` options being enabled.
